message.content:
An editorial illustration depicts a person's torso and hands holding a rifle against a textured, light gray background. The person wears dark-colored, gloved hands and a dark, long-sleeved garment with a pouch attached to a belt at the waist. Their right hand grips the wooden stock near the trigger, while the left hand holds the rifle's forend. The rifle, shown from a low angle, has a dark metal barrel and receiver, and a brown wooden buttstock featuring four vertical scratch marks. A thick, rectangular gray pouch is visible on the figure's right side.

Large red text reads "TEMPO" across the top. Below this, smaller black text states "EDISI 1-7 APRIL 2013". In the upper left, white text reads "JEJARING SUAP HAKIM BANDUNG" and "GERILYA TERAKHIR DI KONGRES DEMOKRAT". To the left of the rifle's stock, large bold black text reads "PEKIK KOMANDO DI CEBONGAN". At the bottom left, text includes "RP 33.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", "ISSN: 0126-4273", and a barcode with the numbers "9 770126 427302" and "00005". A red vertical stripe runs along the left edge.
